queries_run: Expedia Group distribution channel shift AI agents B2B 2026
Expedia Group third quarter 2026 results B2B direct mix business model

findings.claim: 10-K 述及競爭加劇，含供應商直營網站、Gen AI 與 AI agent 業者；B2B 以 Rapid API、白標、TAAP 等通路供貨
findings.excerpt: We face increasing competition from travel supplier direct websites. In some cases, supplier direct channels offer advantages to travelers, such as their own specific loyalty programs, complimentary services such as Wi-Fi, and better pricing.

findings.claim: Q3 2026：B2B 總預訂成長 19%、B2C 7%，B2B 營收成長 23%，B2B 調整後 EBITDA 利潤率下降 134bp 至 27.5%（來源為第三方轉述，非逐字一手）
findings.source: Panabee/搜尋摘要 Expedia Q3 Earnings (2026-11-04 財報)
findings.excerpt: Total Gross Bookings grew 11%, while B2B Gross Bookings grew 19% and B2C Gross Bookings grew 7%.; Revenue grew 12%, driven by B2B, which grew 23%.

findings.claim: Explore 26（2026-05）B2B 預覽 AI 工具包；CEO 稱與 ChatGPT、Claude 有訂位整合，視 AI 助理為分銷夥伴；B2B 營收約占總營收 35%
findings.excerpt: B2B revenue grew 25% in the quarter to $1.18 billion, now representing roughly 35% of total revenue.

channel_business_model_shift.note: excerpt 2、3 為搜尋摘要整理句，非網頁原文，未核原文。
